name: Survey tile in Gemini
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.6 degrees north of the ecliptic in Gemini, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 5 visits over 56 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.3 days starting 2026-03-20, at wavelengths from 0.74 to 4.90 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
